note: Adapted from the species-level description in Hill (1942), original in English; the original work has it as Eutermes mareebensis (the OCR gives the heading as 'mareebensie'). The number of antennal segments of the soldier is given in the OCR as '13, rarely 11+'; '11+' is probably an error for '14' and has not been altered, but is transcribed in the text with a note. The worker head length (to clypeal suture) appears in the OCR as '0.80 -0.8 o', the last character read as 1 from the sense of the passage; the worker pronotum width appears in the OCR as '0.b2 - 0.70', read as 0.62. Distribution, Biology and Affinities from the original are not translated into the morphology sections; the essentials of Affinities are compressed into the diagnostic characters. OCR misreadings: 'Pig.' = 'Fig.', 'labrum' is given as 'lab rum' in several places, and 'mummy brown' is a colour name of the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate is very small, moderately hairy and mummy brown, with small compound eyes and large ocelli, length with wings 7.50—8.50 mm and narrow wings; the original states that its affinities are unknown. The soldier occurs in a large and a small form: head very dark brown, long and narrow, distinctly constricted, nasus about 2/3 the length of the rest of the head; the large soldier somewhat resembles E. nichollsi, the small soldier resembles E. pulleinei but is much darker.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Very small, moderately hairy, mummy brown, with small compound eyes and large ocelli. Abdominal tergites only slightly paler than the head and thorax. Postclypeus yellow brown, about half as long as wide. Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 distinctly shorter and narrower than segment 2 and the shortest of the whole antenna; segment 14 longer than segment 13. First tooth of each mandible longer than the second. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, anterior margin slightly arched, anterolateral angles narrow, sides steeply sloping to the slightly wavy posterior margin; posterior margin of the mesonotum wide and rather deeply concave; posterior margin of the metanotum with a deeper and narrower emargination. Wings narrow, the 6 or 7 basal branches of the radial sector and cubitus very distinct. Measurements: length with wings 7.50—8.50 mm; length without wings 4.10—4.90 mm; head length (to apex of labrum) 0.91 mm; head length (to clypeofrontal suture) 0.44—0.47 mm; head width 0.69—0.73 mm; greatest diameter of compound eye 0.20 mm; ocellus length 0.09—0.10 mm; pronotum length 0.34 mm; pronotum width 0.60—0.62 mm; fore wing length 6.00 mm; fore wing width 1.52 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Large form: body small, head very dark brown, nasus darkest, anterolateral areas palest; antennae and anterior half of the pronotum dark brown, the rest of the pronotum and the abdominal tergites paler. Head long and narrow, distinctly constricted; nasus long and narrow, about 2/3 the length of the rest of the head; dorsal outline of the head in lateral view slightly concave at the middle or almost straight. Antennae 13-segmented (the original records a rare case as "11+", probably an OCR error, see note); segment 2 slightly longer than segment 4; segment 4 the shortest of the whole antenna; segments 3 and 5 about equal; segments 6—8 about equal, longer than segment 5; segments 9—13 shorter than segments 6—8; or, rarely, segment 3 distinctly longer and closely fused with segment 4. Mandibles with or without a pointed tooth (sometimes present on one side only). Small form (not described in the original): as above but slightly paler, head relatively narrower, antennae only 12-segmented (segment 3 the shortest of the whole antenna); segment 2 slightly shorter than segments 4 and 5. Measurements: large form, body length 3.30 mm, head length (to apex of nasus) 1.32—1.35 mm, head width 0.56—0.58 mm, pronotum width 0.42—0.44 mm; small form, body length 3.15 mm, head length (to apex of nasus) 1.21 mm, head width 0.45 mm, pronotum width 0.31 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow brown, with two broad, parallel dark brown lines on each side of the median suture; labrum straw-coloured. Postclypeus slightly more than half as long as wide. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 the shortest of the whole antenna. Measurements: body length 4.50 mm; head length (to apex of labrum) 1.54—1.61 mm; head length (to clypeal suture) 0.80—0.81 mm; head width 1.06—1.13 mm; pronotum width 0.62—0.70 mm.
